info.title: Internal IoT video control
info.description: Service authentication and trusted X-Org-Id/X-User-Id/X-Session-Id headers are required. V2 starts require video_v2_enabled; HEVC also requires video_hevc_chain_ready. Legacy requests and responses retain their original shapes. Agent-ready does not prove decoded frames.
